name: Soldsteps Theme Widgets with Elementor
author: Ashraf Ali

sections.description:
Soldsteps Theme Widgets with Elementor extends Elementor by adding a collection of modern, responsive, and easy-to-use widgets for building professional websites.

The plugin is lightweight, optimized for performance, follows WordPress coding standards, and integrates seamlessly with Elementor.

Included Widgets

  • Slider
  • Counter
  • Team
  • Services
  • Image Accordion
  • Pricing Table
  • Team Tabs
  • Advanced Tabs
  • Accordion

Features

  • Lightweight and fast
  • Fully responsive
  • Easy to customize
  • Clean and secure code
  • Elementor compatible
  • Regular updates
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory or install it through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Install and activate Elementor.
  4. Edit any page with Elementor.
  5. Search for the Soldsteps Addons category to use the widgets.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require Elementor?

Yes. Elementor must be installed and activated.

Is this plugin free?

Yes. It is completely free and licensed under GPL v2 or later.

Are the widgets responsive?

Yes. Every widget is fully responsive.

Can I customize the widgets?

Yes. All widgets include customization options through Elementor controls.
